baselines.guarantee: Fresh canonical installation followed by every active forward migration preserves populated reference and identity rows and exact retry receipts.
Canonical foundation without Principal source/target additions upgrades through the complete active manifests while preserving populated reference and identity rows.

baselines.blocker: Original migration order and checksums survive, but an exact starting schema, populated fixture and reviewed upgrade sequence to the target are not declared.
Actual installation schema, migration receipts and populated-data prerequisites must be captured and mapped to a reviewed supported baseline before schema-dependent onboarding.

limitations: Reconstructed baselines are qualification paths, not claims of historical or deployed support.
Passing paths do not close D7 while required historical or installation paths remain unresolved.
Database rehearsals do not establish publication activation, runtime authorization or browser journey qualification.
